semantics.note: Official semantics REJECT degenerate (flat) isosceles triples. verify_construction iterates every ordered triple (a, b, c) of distinct list positions and fails when dist_sq(a, b) == dist_sq(b, c); its docstring says this 'checks for both standard and degenerate/flat isosceles triangles', and the problem prompt forbids three collinear points P, Q, R with Q the midpoint of PR. Both local oracles implement the same rule, so the local rule is neither stricter nor looser than upstream on the constraint itself.
semantics.upstream_gaps: verify_construction does not check grid bounds; a repeated point is rejected only when the list has at least three entries. Both local oracles additionally require distinct points inside [0, grid_size)^2.
